Fix webhook signature verification failures in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py` causing customer 400s. Pagination work is paused/superseded. An unrelated invoice-report N+1 investigation was performed after the objective was set.

Index on `invoices(customer_id, created_at)`: doubled ingest-path write latency.

Webhook reproduction, inspection, fix, and tests are pending; no exact next command is recorded. Rotation step 4 command/result is status unknown.
